ocr.err_no_langs: Neither Russian nor English is installed in Tesseract.
ocr.err_not_installed: The text recognition program is not installed.
ocr.err_prepare: Could not prepare the image for recognition.
ocr.err_tesseract_read: Tesseract could not read the image.
ocr.err_tesseract_read_detail: Tesseract could not read the image: {detail}
ocr.err_timeout: Recognition took too long. Select a smaller area.
ocr.err_windows_no_lang: No language for text recognition is installed in Windows.
ocr.heading_install: You need to install a recognition program
ocr.heading_windows: You need to turn on text recognition in Windows
ocr.hint_symbols: Rare symbols (₽, ², ©) may be recognized incorrectly.
ocr.lin_err_lock: the package manager is busy with another installation, wait a minute and try again
ocr.lin_err_nopkg: package not found in the system lists, update the package lists and try again
ocr.lin_install_failed: Could not install ({error}). Try “Install manually” below.
ocr.lin_install_started: Installing… The system asks for your password in its own window. This usually takes 1-2 minutes.
ocr.lin_missing_need: Copying text from a picture needs the free recognition program Tesseract. Press “Install recognition”: the system asks for your password, the program does the rest. Internet is needed.
ocr.lin_no_lang_need: The recognition program is installed, but without the “{lang}” language: such text will be read with mistakes. Press “Install recognition”: the system asks for your password and the language is added.
ocr.missing_need_command: Copying text from an image requires Tesseract, a free recognition program. It is installed once with the command below.
ocr.missing_need_guide: Copying text from an image requires Tesseract, a free recognition program. It is installed once following the guide below.
ocr.no_lang_need: The recognition program is installed, but it does not support “{lang}”: text in this language may not be recognized correctly. Add the language using the command below.
ocr.no_rus_need: The recognition program is installed, but without Russian: Russian text will be recognized with errors. Add Russian with the command below.
ocr.note_copied: The text is already on the clipboard. You can edit it here and copy it again.
ocr.note_empty: No text found in the image. Try selecting a larger area or one closer to the text.
ocr.status_installed_nolangs: Installed: Tesseract, but without Russian and English
ocr.status_missing: Not installed: the Tesseract program is needed (how to install it, below).
ocr.status_windows: Built-in Windows recognition is used (the language is taken from those installed in the system)
ocr.terminal_hint: Open a terminal (Ctrl+Alt+T), paste the command (Ctrl+Shift+V), press Enter and enter your password. After the installation, repeat the recognition or translation.
ocr.title: Text from image
ocr.win_install_declined: Installation cancelled: administrator permission was not given. Click the button again and answer “Yes”.
ocr.win_install_done: Done: recognition is installed. Recognize the text again.
ocr.win_install_failed: Could not install ({error}). Install it manually using the steps above.
ocr.win_install_started: Windows will ask permission for its own program DISM (publisher Microsoft): this is normal, click “Yes”. Installing takes 1-3 minutes; “Done” will appear here when it finishes.
ocr.win_lang_guide_title: Microsoft guide: how to add a language in Windows
ocr.win_lang_need: Windows has no Russian text recognition installed, so Russian letters come out as Latin ones. Click “Install recognition”: Windows will ask for permission; it takes 1-3 minutes and needs the internet. Manually: open “Settings → Time & language → Language & region”, click “…” next to “Russian” → “Language options” and download “Optical character recognition”. If Russian is not in the list, first “Add a language” → “Russian”. Another option: the free Tesseract program (second link), ClipSD will find it by itself.
ocr.win_lang_need_lang: Windows has no text recognition for {lang} installed. Click “Install recognition”: Windows will ask for permission; it takes 1-3 minutes and needs the internet. Manually: open “Settings → Time & language → Language & region”, click “…” next to that language → “Language options” and download “Optical character recognition”. If the language is not in the list, first “Add a language”. Another option: the free Tesseract program (second link), ClipSD will find it by itself.
